subject: Successful early termination must retain authenticated unexecuted root Events in the catalog
reproduction: Admit current authorities, check and compile the maintained Model Source, then independently admit its RIR.
Bind the maintained Experiment to that RIR and set the first scenario terminal_condition to event-count with maximum 1.
Control: keep the original root Event. Check, prepare and evaluate the Experiment, then validate each member and the complete result set.
Variant: copy the first event_plan item, change root_event_ref to unexecuted-later-root and logical_time to 10, and append it to the same scenario. Repeat the complete checked execution.
cause: The successful journal catalog equality includes committed, scheduled and canceled Event IDs but omits authenticated, unexecuted authored roots already owned by expected_root_map.
required_followup: Use the authoritative root map when checking catalog completeness. Retain individual record, scheduling, state and Formula evidence checks; add a permanent legitimate early-termination regression and a counterfeit-root rejection.
scope: This issue reproduces before #877 and remains assigned to #879. The in-memory equality bypass is causal evidence only, not the proposed production fix.
